end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used examples such as a standing flagpole and a sleeping book edge.
Discussed that tilted/slanting lines can still be straight if they do not bend.
The slanting-is-not-straight mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (turns 9–10).
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 7 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines with Om using everyday examples. Om used the direction of a line to explain the difference and later corrected the mix-up that a slanting line is not straight: it can be tilted without bending. At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type and check whether each line bends.
